Name: Item bag for Quaint Living - Flower Garden 2
Author: HazelMQ
Description:
[b][size=4]Description[/size][/b]
The item bags for Quaint Living - Flower Garden 2.
To be honest,  Quaint Living 1 could be influence, I did not test. For this mod it did not a main unique ID.
I use ID prefix "QL", so in the future if a mod use QL as prefix and this bag could have more items.:)
But I will keep view it. If you find it is influence by other mod, please tell me I will try other words to change this mod.
Quaint Living - 花园 2 的物品袋。
老实说，Quaint Living 1 可能会有影响，我没有测试。对于这个模组，它没有主唯一 ID。
我使用 ID 前缀“QL”，所以将来如果有模组使用 QL 作为ID前缀，这个袋子可能会有更多物品。:)
但我会继续关注。如果你发现它受其他模组影响，请告诉我，我会尝试用其他词来更改这个模组。

[b][size=4]Installation instructions[/size][/b]
Extract the compressed package to the location where the item bag is installed. 
Keep the .json in "......\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods\......\Item Bags\ItemBags\assets\Modded Bags"
将压缩包解压至item bag安装的文件夹，保证.json文件在item bag的 Modded Bags内。
